text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired (PDINC-7832) — Hosted inference: increased tail latency and 502 errors for model 'redwood/open-13b-v2' in us-west-2. Affected routes: /v1/generate. Threshold: 95th > 1500ms; current: 95th = ~2300ms; error rate spike +4.7% :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident PDINC-7832 paging primary on-call Sam K (oncall-sam). Escalation policy: watch-mode -> secondary after 5m -> manager after 15m.

Sam K: ugh, just woke up. checking prod now.

Sam K: acked PDINC-7832 (trying to see logs).

pagerduty-bot: Ack received from Sam K at 1970012360. No further escalation required unless not resolved in 10m.

Priya R: pinging in case you need an extra pair — I'm secondary. seeing same at console, lots of 502s hitting gpu-proxy-1.

Sam K: looking at logs. kernel OOMs? not seeing OOM, see long queuing in runtime worker (avg queue wait 1.7s). requests backing up.

Sam K: rolling a quick scale: increasing replica_count for us-west-2 inference pool by +30% (auto-scale didn't kick). running: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy/inference-pool-usw2 --replicas=13`

Jordan L: heads up — we have a model rollout (open-13b-v2 quantized) that started 12:02 UTC, traffic split 10%. could be related.

Sam K: thanks. switching traffic off the new variant for safety. `redwood route update --model open-13b-v2:canary --weight 0`

pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation: primary on-call Sam K did not resolve within 10m, policy triggered secondary notification to Priya R at 1970012425.

Priya R: I'm on. can confirm removing canary reduced tail on a small test, but overall cluster still high. next step: drain one overloaded node, check kernel logs, and failover traffic to dedicated pool.

Sam K: draining node gpu-node-17 now: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-17 && kubectl drain gpu-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Sam K: node had high cpu steal and some nvlink errors in dmesg. escalating to infra if hardware flaky. @ops-manager - can you check hardware alerts?

ops-manager: looking. NVLink ECC errors flagged on gpu-node-17, scheduling hardware investigation. Initiating short-term mitigation: routing new inference requests to dedicated-usw2-pool.

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation policy: no ack from manager within 15m -> manager notified. (manager watch window continuing).

pagerduty-bot: PDINC-7832 escalated to ops-manager (manager) at 1970012500 — manager notified.

ops-manager: acked and joining. good catch draining node. is customer impact high? which customers?

Priya R: impact: 8 paid tenants saw SLA breaches (token latency > 2s), status page POST in progress. I've started a targeted mitigation: `traffic-shift --from inference-pool-usw2 --to dedicated-usw2 --weight 100 --timeout 30s` — shifting now.

Sam K: after shifting, error rate dropped from +4.7% to +0.6% within 60s. 95th latency down to ~980ms.

ops-manager: great. continuing monitoring. please prepare short blameless summary and timeline for follow-up. also need to update runbook: autoscaler failed to trigger; check scaling controller logs.

Priya R: noted. I'm collecting timestamps and commands to paste into incident doc. also will add note: mobile DND for Sam meant he only saw PD page when alarms escalated — we may want to test critical-page timeouts for first-contact.

Sam K: sorry about delay — phone didn't surface critical page. I'll review personal PD settings.

Jordan L: follow-ups: (1) revert canary rollout hold, (2) add a preflight check before canary that ensures baseline queue latency < 600ms, (3) increase min replicas for usw2 pool.

ops-manager: agreed. action items assigned: Sam -> check autoscaler controller and node health (issue ticket INF-1429), Priya -> prepare customer impact and status page draft, Jordan -> add preflight gating for rollouts, ops-manager -> hardware ticket for gpu-node-17.

sam k: quick note for timeline in the doc:
- 1970012345 pagerduty page fired (PDINC-7832)
- 1970012360 Sam K acked (primary)
- 1970012425 auto-escalation to Priya R (secondary triggered)
- 1970012440 draining node gpu-node-17 initiated
- 1970012465 traffic shift to dedicated-usw2 started
- 1970012490 error rate down to ~0.6%
- 1970012500 manager ops-manager acked

Priya R: adding: status page posted (partial outage, mitigation in progress).

pagerduty-bot: PDINC-7832 acknowledged by ops-manager and marked as monitored. No active major outage declared.

ops-manager: wrapping up — will schedule postmortem next week, invite runbook owners. thanks everyone for quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

Sam K: filing INF-1429 with logs and autoscaler traces. linking to incident doc.

Priya R: adding customer list & impact notes to incident doc. will set severity and notify sales ops for affected tenants.

Jordan L: I'll add a quick unit test for rollout-gate and a dashboard alert for NVLink errors.

incident-bot: Thread archived after 1h of inactivity.
